parts.text: I am planning a camping trip in Maine, specifically Acadia National Park. We definitely require a campground that has showers located on-site.

Checks campgrounds in Acadia ('acad') using get_campgrounds. Accurately evaluates on-site shower availability from NPS evidence. Accurately reports that Acadia NPS campgrounds (such as Blackwoods, Seawall, or Schoodic Woods) do not have on-site showers (only pay showers in nearby communities outside the park, which do not count as on-site). Does not pad recommendations or claim nearby off-site showers are on-site showers.
Which campgrounds in Acadia National Park have flush toilets and dump stations available?

Queries get_campgrounds for 'acad'. Grounds response strictly in official NPS amenities data, identifying campgrounds such as Blackwoods or Seawall that document flush toilets and dump stations, citing official links and preserving any seasonal uncertainties.
Does Blackwoods Campground in Acadia National Park offer free public Wi-Fi and satellite TV hookups at the campsites?
Inspects NPS campground amenities data. Preserves missing, unlisted, or unknown amenities as unverified/unknown rather than fabricating availability or assuming yes or no.
Can you recommend a campground inside Acadia National Park that has a heated indoor swimming pool and individual sewer hookups at tent-only sites?
Consults get_campgrounds for 'acad' and honestly explains that no campgrounds in Acadia meet these criteria, refusing to pad recommendations with unverified or unsuitable places.
Please check live campsite availability and reserve a tent site for me at Blackwoods Campground for tomorrow night.

Respects read-only boundaries: politely declines to reserve or check real-time inventory, explains that it cannot perform bookings, and points the user to the official reservation link (e.g., Recreation.gov).
Are there any active closures or hazard advisories in Acadia National Park that might affect our stay?
Queries get_alerts for Acadia ('acad'), reports active alerts or closure scopes accurately without assuming an empty feed guarantees zero closures.
